SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT /*ProductDAO.selectWheelList*/ @ROWNUM := @ROWNUM + 1 AS ROWNUM /*순번*/ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_wheel A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND WHEEL_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND ADT_DSC LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
) AS TOTAL_CNT /*전체개수*/ , WHEEL_ID /*wheel아이디*/ , WHEEL_NM /*wheel명*/ , EXPS_YN /*노출여부*/ , DATE_FORMAT(CREAT_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CREAT_DTTM /*등록일자*/ , DATE_FORMAT(UPDT_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS UPDT_DTTM /*수정일자*/ FROM tb_wheel , (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) AS TEMP WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
AND WHEEL_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND ADT_DSC LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY WHEEL_ID DESC ) A WHERE A.ROWNUM BETWEEN (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) * IFNULL(#{page}, 1)) - (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) - 1) AND (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) * IFNULL(#{page}, 1))

SELECT /*ProductDAO.selectWheelListById*/ TW.WHEEL_ID /*wheel아이디*/ , TW.WHEEL_NM /*wheel명*/ , TW.WHEEL_IMG_ID /*wheel이미지아이디*/ , TF.FILE_NM AS WHEEL_IMG_NM /*wheel이미지명*/ , CONCAT(TF.PATH, TF.RE_FILE_NM, '.', TF.FILE_TYPE) AS WHEEL_IMG_PATH /*wheel이미지경로*/ , TW.ADT_DSC /*부가설명*/ , TW.SIZE_CNTN /*가능한사이즈내용*/ , TW.DEGN_CNTN /*디자인내용*/ , TW.EXPS_YN /*노출여부*/ FROM tb_wheel TW LEFT JOIN tb_file TF ON TW.WHEEL_IMG_ID = TF.FILE_ID WHERE TW.WHEEL_ID = #{wheelId} AND TW.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT /*ProductDAO.selectExhstList*/ @ROWNUM := @ROWNUM + 1 AS ROWNUM /*순번*/ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_exhst A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N') AS TOTAL_CNT /*전체개수*/ , TE.EXHST_ID /*배기아이디*/ , TE.EXHST_IMG_ID /*배기이미지아이디*/ , CONCAT(TF.PATH, TF.RE_FILE_NM, '.', TF.FILE_TYPE) AS EXHST_IMG_PATH /*배기이미지경로*/ , TE.DISP_PRI /*전시순위*/ , TE.DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ FROM tb_exhst TE , tb_file TF , (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) AS TEMP WHERE TE.EXHST_IMG_ID = TF.FILE_ID AND TE.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY TE.DISP_PRI ) A WHERE A.ROWNUM BETWEEN (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) * IFNULL(#{page}, 1)) - (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) - 1) AND (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) * IFNULL(#{page}, 1))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_exhst /*ProductDAO.insertExhst*/ ( EXHST_ID , EXHST_IMG_ID , DISP_PRI , DEL_YN , CREAT_DTTM , CRTR_ID , UPDT_DTTM , UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(EXHST_ID) + 1, 1) FROM tb_exhst A) , #{exhstImgId} , 1 , 'N' , now() , #{crtrId} , now() , #{crtrId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_exhst /*ProductDAO.updateExhstDispPriAll*/ SET DISP_PRI = DISP_PRI + 1 WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT /*ProductDAO.selectCrbnList*/ @ROWNUM := @ROWNUM + 1 AS ROWNUM /*순번*/ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_crbn A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N') AS TOTAL_CNT /*전체개수*/ , TC.CRBN_ID /*카본파이버아이디*/ , TC.CRBN_IMG_ID /*카본파이버이미지아이디*/ , CONCAT(TF.PATH, TF.RE_FILE_NM, '.', TF.FILE_TYPE) AS CRBN_IMG_PATH /*카본파이버이미지경로*/ , TC.DISP_PRI /*전시순위*/ , TC.DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ FROM tb_crbn TC , tb_file TF , (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) AS TEMP WHERE TC.CRBN_IMG_ID = TF.FILE_ID AND TC.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY DISP_PRI ) A WHERE A.ROWNUM BETWEEN (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) * IFNULL(#{page}, 1)) - (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) - 1) AND (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) * IFNULL(#{page}, 1))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_crbn /*ProductDAO.insertCrbn*/ ( CRBN_ID , CRBN_IMG_ID , DISP_PRI , DEL_YN , CREAT_DTTM , CRTR_ID , UPDT_DTTM , UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CRBN_ID) + 1, 1) FROM tb_crbn A) , #{crbnImgId} , 1 , 'N' , now() , #{crtrId} , now() , #{crtrId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_crbn /*ProductDAO.updateCrbnDispPriAll*/ SET DISP_PRI = DISP_PRI + 1 WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
